text_en: You will say in that day: I will give thanks to you, O Lord , for though you were angry with me, your anger turned away, and you comforted me.
text_cn: 当那日，你要说：“上主！我称颂你，因为你虽向我发了怒，但你的怒气已止息，并且还安慰了我。

text_en: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid, for the Lord God is my strength and my might; he has become my salvation.
text_cn: 看哪！天主是我的救援，我依靠他，决不畏惧，因为上主是我的力量，是我的歌颂，他确是我的救援。

text_en: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.
text_cn: 你们要愉快地从救援的泉源里汲水。”

text_en: And you will say in that day: Give thanks to the Lord , call on his name; make known his deeds among the nations; proclaim that his name is exalted.
text_cn: 那一日，你要说：“你们应称颂上主，呼号他的名！将他的作为宣告于万民，称述他的名是崇高的。

text_en: Sing praises to the Lord , for he has done gloriously; let this be known in all the earth.
text_cn: 请歌颂上主，因为他行了显赫的事，这事应该遍传天下。

text_en: Shout aloud and sing for joy, O royal Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 熙雍的居民，你们应欢呼高唱，因为以色列的圣者在你们中间是伟大的。”
